steps.clue: Throw a Gersh Device outside the map to pull in the generator.
Activate the glowing monitor beneath the stairs near the Stamin-Up Lunar Lander.
Simultaneously press the buttons beside the four Perk Machines during a Space Monkey round.
Stand on the pressure plate facing the clock for two minutes.
Collect the letters in the sky to spell L-U-N-A.
Use a Gersh Device on the orb, then attack with upgraded Wonder Weapons and Matryoshka Dolls.
